description: Dry-run one tap on a link from one kind of device or app and see exactly what Strait would do (redirect, in-app-browser escape page, store, preview card) and why. Nothing is recorded or billed. ua is a preset or a raw User-Agent string.

slug.description: The link's slug: the part after the link domain, e.g. `summer` in https://hilltop.strait.link/summer

ua.description: A preset (android, iphone, ipad, desktop, instagram-ios, instagram-android, facebook-android, whatsapp-android, bot) or a raw User-Agent

url.description: The full short link instead of slug

name: simulate_tap
title: Simulate a tap
